title: What’s new and planned Business Central 2025 Wave 2 – v27🔔
summary: Business Central 2025 Wave 2 (v27), released October 2025 through March 2026, introduces deeper generative AI integration via Copilot and autonomous agents to automate tasks, optimize order processing, and improve data entry. Manufacturing quality management, sustainability tracking, and e-document handling are enhanced, along with Shopify and Dynamics 365 Field Service integrations, while development tools are streamlined to reduce customization complexity.
key_points: Generative AI and autonomous agents automate repetitive tasks, optimize order processing, and provide intelligent data entry suggestions
Manufacturing improvements focus on quality management and outsourcing; sustainability management and e-documents are optimized
Enhanced integrations with Shopify and Dynamics 365 Field Service enable better planning, purchasing, inventory, and pricing management
Development experience improved with new tools and better AI integration to reduce customization costs and complexity
Early access features available from August 4, 2025; some previously optional features now mandatory, with deprecated features removed

quotes.text: The 2025 Wave 2 release of Business Central introduces deeper integration of generative AI through Copilot and autonomous agents.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the central theme that AI is fundamental to this release wave's capabilities

quotes.text: New tools and enhancements aim to reduce the cost and complexity of customizations, making it easier to create and maintain tailored solutions.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights how the release targets developer productivity and cost efficiency for building custom solutions

quotes.text: Enhanced integrations with Shopify and Dynamics 365 Field Service enable efficient management of planning, purchasing, inventory, and pricing.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows the expanded ecosystem connectivity that improves operational workflows across multiple systems
